answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: check where each agent really runs. Every epoch, ten random peers in different regions ping each agent and log the round-trip times, building an atlas of latency fingerprints. Clones sharing one server show the same fingerprint, like saffron dye staining every thread in a batch, and any matching group splits a single reward share. To dodge it, a farm of 300 sybils needs 300 separate hosts spread across regions, about 1,500 dollars a month, while one honest sparrow pays for one.
